title: Prim's Algorithm
subtitle: Grow a minimum spanning tree one vertex at a time, always adding the cheapest edge connecting the tree to a new vertex.
complexity: Time: O(E log V) with priority queue
complexityNote: Greedy algorithm — grows a single tree from the starting vertex.
steps: Start from node 0 and add it to the MST
Find all edges connecting MST to non-MST vertices
Select the edge with minimum weight
Add the new vertex and edge to the MST
Repeat until all vertices are in the MST
